items.html: These eleven signs of the incense are but one phase, which is the Noga [radiance] around it, and corresponding to it in Yetzira, Beria, and Atzilut. That shell of Noga is called “Ruach Elokim Merachefet” [lit. the spirit of God hovered], whose letters are Mem-Tav Peh-Reish-Het [Hebrew: died, flew away]. These are the 288 sparks of the kings that died, and this shell is made of the 288 sparks that remained inside the vessels and were not sorted. It hovers over the shells and does not enter them.
